name: What factors determine the cost of installing a tile backsplash?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of installing a tile backsplash?

acceptedAnswer.text: Backsplash installation costs depend on the square footage, the type of tile chosen, wall condition, and the complexity of cuts. Basic ceramic subway tile on a clean, flat wall sits at the lower end of the labor scale. Intricate patterns like herringbone, small mosaic sheets, or thick natural stone require substantially more cutting time and precision around outlets, under-cabinet lighting, and corners. If the existing wall has significant drywall damage or old adhesive that must be scraped and repaired before tiling, labor time increases accordingly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Total cost is determined by overall square footage, the tile material, layout complexity (such as herringbone), and the amount of wall repair needed prior to installation.
